Description: A blog-writer run is judged on whether it read the house structure before writing, named the artifact it produced, handed it to review, and avoided unsourced authority claims.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Named the artifact it produced
Criteria.Statement: A draft nobody can find is not a deliverable.

Criteria.Name: Read the house structure first
Criteria.Statement: The run wrote a post without checking how existing posts are structured.

Criteria.Name: Handed the draft to review
Criteria.Statement: A draft that does not declare review readiness stalls the pipeline.

Criteria.Name: No unsourced authority claims
Criteria.Statement: The handoff asserts authority the draft cannot cite.
